description: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating classification accuracy results (in percent) for different model variants/ablations on the PolitiFact dataset, with two side-by-side groups separated by a vertical dashed line. The category axis is horizontal and lists the same six variants in each group—“Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o text,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition”—shown in that order with diagonally rotated labels; the value axis is vertical, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, using a linear scale with labeled ticks from 75.0 up to 95.0 at regular 2.5-point intervals. In the left group, the bars (each with a numeric label above) are: “Ours” in dark maroon at 89.84, “w/o comments” in orange at 86.82, “w/o text” in pale yellow at 80.10, “w/o select” in very light blue at 88.80, “w/o emotion” in medium light blue at 87.34, and “w/o cognition” in dark blue at 87.17. In the right group, the corresponding bars are: “Ours” (dark maroon) at 90.57, “w/o comments” (orange) at 85.85, “w/o text” (pale yellow) at 83.02, “w/o select” (very light blue) at 89.62, “w/o emotion” (medium light blue) at 84.91, and “w/o cognition” (dark blue) at 87.74. The bars are not shown as stacked; they are arranged as two repeated sets of the same categories, and the chart includes the title text “PolitiFact” near the upper right, with no legend visible and no special highlighting beyond the value annotations and the dashed divider between the two groups.
